activity.notes: Al-Zahir Baybars ruled the Mamluk Sultanate for seventeen years, 1260–1277, and was one of the formative early Mamluk sultans. ATLAS reuses the existing Mamluk Sultanate polity and records the established year-level reign.

sources.citation_text: The Metropolitan Museum publication identifies Baybars as a prominent early Mamluk leader who ruled for seventeen years, 1260–1277, and notes that 1277 was the year of his death.
